title: Who’s looking after this place?
html:
Over the weekend I had a conversation with a policeman I know and something he said really stood out for me.

He was talking about a funny situation where all the patrolling policemen ended up in the same place, at the same time. He thought to himself, "Who's looking after this place?"

I asked him if this was the attitude of most policemen he knew. He said it was and that they really take responsibility for protecting the community. It was cool to hear this and it gave me peace of mind.

If we all had this attitude, would that make a big difference in our workplace or community? I feel sure it would.
